title: 7 Things Jesus Did in the Upper Room Before He Ever Led Anyone
caption:
Before Jesus led anyone anywhere, he knelt down and washed their feet. Judas included.

Leadership that costs you nothing isn't leadership. It's a title. He picked up the towel before he ever asked for the room.

Pick up your towel before you ask for yours.

#faith #leadership #christianmen #servantleadership #manofgod
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
